title: Partial backlog implementation sweep (implementation first, verify deferred)
acceptance_criteria: Convert partial backlog items to implementation-complete status by closing guide-leaf gaps in UI/backend.
Keep UI/API workflows form-driven (no free-form CLI primary workflows).
Run validation gates after each completed slice (pytest + tsc/eslint + build + smoke).
Defer live-environment verification to explicit verify phase after implementation backlog closure.
assumptions: Backlog status `verify` is the implementation-complete state for this pass.
Live dual-node or hardware-specific validation remains outside this implementation pass.

System Identification no longer pushes resolver-owned name-server state.
X-04 smoke route coverage expanded to all current static app pages; browser exclusion for onboarding redirect flow.
X-01 parity thresholds now enforced in CI.
SYS-09 parity completed (structured SSH key entries + OTP rate-time) and moved to verify.

SYS-01 complete: expanded conntrack page/API for timeout defaults, custom timeout rules, ignore rules, and logging controls with validation; moved to verify.

Cross-cutting depth improved: added advanced conntrack fixture loop and richer conntrack snapshot coverage; pytest suite passed.
X-02/X-03 command-delta depth pass: loop tests now assert emitted command deltas for set/delete operations; backlog items promoted to verify.
Container Management layout pass: enforced 2-column composition (Containers left; Image Lifecycle/Registries/Networks collapsed + Create Container right) with responsive ordering.

Fixed update-check save bug where enabling auto-check with default URL could omit URL operation; URL is now materialized before auto-check and client enforces URL-required when auto-check is enabled.
Dashboard drag/drop reliability fix: collision detection now prioritizes pointerWithin targets (column overlays) with closestCorners fallback for more reliable cross-column card moves.
DNS Resolver UX improvement: `listen-address` values can now be selected from detected interface runtime IPs (checkbox quick-pick), while keeping manual CSV input for advanced/manual entry.
Addressed operator-reported follow-ups: DNS quick-pick selection persistence/disabled-state issues fixed and Interface Overview WAN role no longer falls back to first interface (eth0).
Dashboard drag/drop fix: compaction now preserves selected target column, preventing dropped cards from snapping back.

DNS forwarding allow-from default hotfix: when forwarding is enabled and allow-from is empty/omitted, backend now seeds permissive defaults (0.0.0.0/0 and ::/0). Added regression tests for both empty and omitted payloads.
Consolidated DNS Forwarder/Resolver into one DNS tab and added `Populate Suggested Defaults` action driven by discovered interface/gateway data.

Protocol static/failover verification depth: added failover + static-protocol loop fixtures and snapshots; protocol capability + loop + snapshot suites pass.
Added dedicated BGP save/apply/reload integration test to cover op/value batch semantics and builder execution path not represented in generic command-string loops.
Added dedicated static-routes save/apply/reload regression covering StaticRoutesBatchRequest destination/route_type/op-value contract and config round-trip assertions.

commands.test: cd backend && PYTHONPATH=. ./.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/test_static_routes_save_apply_reload_loop.py tests/test_bgp_save_apply_reload_loop.py tests/test_protocol_capabilities.py tests/test_fixture_save_apply_reload_loops.py tests/test_domain_config_snapshots.py && cd ../frontend && npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false && npm run -s build && npm run -s smoke:runtime
